Generative AI animation is animation made with AI image and video models under an artist’s direction — designed, directed, and edited like any other film. This page explains the medium, and how a Melbourne studio uses it for brands, documentaries, events, and original series.

What is generative AI animation?

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text css=""]

Generative AI animation is animation created with artificial-intelligence image and video models, directed by an artist rather than generated from a text prompt alone. At Oddtoe it is a hybrid workflow: for consistency and easy amendment, generated imagery is combined with character rigging and traditional motion design, so the result holds one style across every scene.

Oddtoe is an experiential design and generative-AI animation studio based in Melbourne, creating projection, installation, and animated work for events, venues, and galleries.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="80" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="80" screen_tablet_spacer_size="80" screen_mobile_spacer_size="80"][dfd_heading enable_delimiter="" style="style_02" heading_margin="margin-bottom:20px;" subtitle="Brands, filmmakers, institutions..." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_size:70|line_height:64" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_size:38|line_height:32"]

Who uses it, and for what?

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text css=""]

Brands use generative AI animation for branded content, characters, and social video; documentary makers use it for animated maps, diagrams, and reconstructions; venues and events use it for screen and projection content. Oddtoe works both as a studio in its own right and as a resource inside other studios’ productions.

Inside other productions, Oddtoe takes whichever role the project needs — art director, head of animation, lead animator, character designer, or background artist. That flexibility is a feature of the medium: generative AI compresses the production pipeline, so one experienced generative AI animator can carry roles that once needed a department. For brand teams, that means animated content at a pace and budget that hand animation rarely allows.

Where AI animation fits in real work

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="15" screen_mobile_spacer_size="19"][vc_column_text css=""]

Branded content and social video. Short, styled animation for campaigns, YouTube channels, and social feeds — where a brand needs a cohesive look across many pieces. Art direction is what keeps the hundredth video matching the first.

Documentary graphics. Animated maps, ways to visualise time and place, conceptual diagrams, reconstructions — the possible styles for documentary animation are enormous, and generative tools widen them further. Oddtoe works in 2D and 3D non-fiction animation, with a visual-storytelling background that began at National Geographic.

Characters that persist. A designed character, kept consistent across episodes, formats, and campaigns — raw AI tools struggle with this; a directed workflow is built for it.

Screens, events, and projection. Looping animated content for event screens and projection — AI animation supplies the moving content for physical experiences, and it appears throughout our brand activation ideas.

Original series and art. Oddtoe also makes its own work — original stories generated with AI and the human mind, including The Top 100 Comedians of All Time Will Be Bots (Oddtoe, 2023). Making our own series keeps the studio current with the tools.

AI, DIY, or traditional — which fits?

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text css=""]

The honest comparison — where each approach shines:

 Traditional animationDIY prompt toolsArtist-led AI studio
Who makes itAnimators, frame by frameYou, prompting a toolAn artist directing AI models
Style consistency between scenesConsistentChanges from shot to shotConsistent — held by character design and rigging
Typical time to a first cutWeeks to monthsMinutesDays to weeks
Making a changeRedrawn by handRe-generate and hope — each attempt differsEdited directly — characters stay rigged
Best forSignature hand-crafted filmsQuick experimentsBrand campaigns, series, and client work

How does the hybrid workflow work?

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text css=""]

Oddtoe’s process is a hybrid workflow: generative AI models supply imagery and movement, and — for consistency and easy amendment — Oddtoe combines them with character rigging and traditional motion design. The artist designs first, generates second, then rigs, edits, and composites, so a revision is an edit, not a fresh generation.

That structure is what makes the medium dependable enough for client work: a change to a character, a colour, or a line of action is made the way animators have always made it, with the AI doing the expensive rendering underneath. Oddtoe has prototyped and documented five distinct methods — from illustration-first motion design to repeatable AI-rigged characters and straight-to-video with an illustration filter — on our AI animation process page, and the full capability lives on the generative AI animator page.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Why the artist matters

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="15" screen_mobile_spacer_size="19"][vc_column_text css=""]

Anyone can generate a striking image. The difficult part is generating the same world twice: a character who looks the same in every scene, and a style your brand can use again and again. Raw AI consistency is not there yet, which is why every Oddtoe method begins with a quality illustration and lets the AI interpret the scene. The craft is in the direction.

The studio’s range comes from an unusual résumé: political cartoonist, puppeteer, data visualiser, street artist — and, since 2006, work for organisations including National Geographic. Each of those jobs relies on deciding what an image should communicate before making it, and that judgement is what generative AI work needs most.

AI systems also produce permutations, glitches, and odd choices. Under direction those can become material: Oddtoe’s original stories use that strangeness on purpose, while commercial work keeps it controlled. Either way, an artist is making the choice.

If your team is weighing up AI animation, the most useful question is who will be directing it. Send Oddtoe the brief — the studio supplies the design, rigging, and motion design that turn generated frames into a finished film.


[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30" screen_mobile_spacer_size="38"][dfd_delimiter delimiter_style="dfd-delimiter-with-icon" icon_size="30" delimiter_border_style="dotted" icon_fontawesome="fas fa-arrow-circle-down" show_icon="enable_icon" delim_line_color="#8224E31C" icon_color="#EEE6F6" icon_hover_color="#D4C9E0"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30" screen_mobile_spacer_size="38"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/6"][/vc_column][/vc_row] [vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_enable_overlay="" dfd_row_config="full_width_content_paddings" el_id="pat-section-2"][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][dfd_heading enable_delimiter="" style="style_02" heading_margin="margin-bottom:20px;" subtitle="The right tool for the brief..." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_size:70|line_height:64" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_size:38|line_height:32"]

When should you choose AI animation?

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text css=""]

Choose generative AI animation when you need animated content at pace or scale — series, campaigns, screen content — or looks that would be impractical to shoot or hand-animate, and when style consistency matters enough that you want an artist directing it.

It is not the right tool for everything: some briefs are better served by hand animation, and some by live action. Oddtoe works across generative AI, motion design, and physical media, and will tell you which approach suits the brief before you commit to one.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Questions & Answers

Generative AI animation

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][dfd_accordion style="style-3" active_section="1" font_size="18" tab_title_google_fonts="yes" tab_title_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal" icon_size="14"][vc_tta_section title="Is generative AI animation just typing prompts?" tab_id="1685677784578-172f9372-59216fce-87a69a68-2eae"][vc_column_text css=""]

No. At Oddtoe it is a hybrid workflow: generative AI supplies imagery and movement, and for consistency and easy amendment Oddtoe combines it with character rigging and traditional motion design, under an artist’s direction. Prompting produces raw material; design, rigging, and editing turn it into finished, revisable film.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Can AI animation keep a consistent brand style?" tab_id="1685677784323-438be9dd-da0e6fce-87a69a68-2eae"][vc_column_text css=""]

Yes — with character design and art direction up front. Brands have longer-term needs and a cohesive style to protect, and an artist-led workflow is built to hold that consistency across shots and campaigns.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Can generative AI animation be used in documentaries?" tab_id="1685677784395-526dd6ff-b9c26fce-87a69a68-2eae"][vc_column_text css=""]

Yes. Animated maps, ways to visualise time and place, conceptual diagrams, and reconstructions all suit the medium. Oddtoe works as a 2D and 3D documentary animator, with a visual-storytelling background that began at National Geographic.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Can AI animation be part of a live event or activation?" tab_id="1685677784507-83427dcb-7a756fce-87a69a68-2eae"][vc_column_text css=""]

Naturally — looping content for event screens and projection is one of its best uses, and it pairs with physical builds in our brand activation ideas. One directed character or world can run on screens, projection, and social at once.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Do you work inside other studios’ productions?" tab_id="1786584255290-781b75e9-21a0"][vc_column_text css=""]

Yes. Oddtoe regularly joins other studios’ projects as art director, head of animation, lead animator, character designer, or background artist — whichever role the production needs.

pages/13203.content:
[vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_enable_overlay="" dfd_row_config="full_width_content" css=".vc_custom_1728879474429{background-color: #252525 !important;}"][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="200" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_mobile_spacer_size="80" screen_normal_spacer_size="200" screen_tablet_spacer_size="100"][dfd_heading delimiter_settings="border-bottom-style:solid;|border-bottom-width:1px;|width:100px;|border-bottom-color:;" style="style_02" title_font_options="tag:h2|font_family:BebasNeueRegular|color:%23ffffff|font_style_bold:1" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_family:QwigleyRegular" subtitle="Innovation from Oddtoe"]Need an Experiential Designer?[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="30" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_mobile_spacer_size="30" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30"][vc_column_text css=""]

My background is in cartooning, graphic design, and data visualization so you'll see those influences in my humor, art, and way of thinking.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="60" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="60" screen_tablet_spacer_size="60" screen_mobile_spacer_size="60"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_enable_overlay=""][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" css=".vc_custom_1728883313202{border: 20px initial !important;}" col_inner_shadow="box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)" col_inner_shadow_hover="box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)"][dfd_heading delimiter_settings="border-bottom-style:solid;|border-bottom-width:1px;|width:50px;|border-bottom-color:#dddddd;" style="style_02" subtitle="If you're into..." title_font_options="tag:h3" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_family:QwigleyRegular"]Arts & Entertainment[/dfd_heading][vc_column_text css=""]

VISUALIZATIONS to AMUSE

This is the "About Oddtoe" section, so I might as well show you around. I like and do a lot of types of art. Some of the favorites are street art, projection art, animation, and installation art. Want to amuse and stir the happy emotions of your audience? Welcome to my world.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="55" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="55" screen_tablet_spacer_size="55" screen_mobile_spacer_size="45"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][dfd_heading delimiter_settings="border-bottom-style:solid;|border-bottom-width:1px;|width:50px;|border-bottom-color:#dddddd;" style="style_02" subtitle="The analog world..." title_font_options="tag:h3" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_family:QwigleyRegular"]Built Environments[/dfd_heading][vc_column_text css=""]

PHYSICAL THINGS of WHIMSY

I adore the twin arts of garden and park design and sculpture. The logical child of these creative practices is topiary, of course. Therefore, I design in 3d with organic shapes in mind. I often slam my shoe at government council meetings, demanding quirkier and more memorable public spaces. (So should you.)[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="55" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="55" screen_tablet_spacer_size="55" screen_mobile_spacer_size="45"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][dfd_heading delimiter_settings="border-bottom-style:solid;|border-bottom-width:1px;|width:50px;|border-bottom-color:#dddddd;" style="style_02" subtitle="The universe expands..." title_font_options="tag:h3" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_family:QwigleyRegular"]Three Dimensional & A.I.[/dfd_heading][vc_column_text css=""]

DEEPER DIVES

I love a good third dimension and I also think I'm lucky to live in this new era of artificial intelligence. Those are two things you should know about me. Sculpture, animation, and prop art design are what I'm into — all visual art that leverages 3D and AI, if writing under the pseudonym, Oddtoe. Oddtoe has taken on new forms over the years. Since the pandemic in 2020, I pushed aside is my pen-and-ink style of illustration, and picked up an iPad Pro, experimented heavily with digital caricature and imaging compositing.[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]I'm loving the result and the new tools in this new pipeline of work. Oddtoe as a business pairs up nicely alongside my data visualization agency, Datalabs. As part of my parent company, Data Arts, Oddtoe is taking on studio animation, art commissions, and 3d design projects. Transforming ideas into tangible, breathtaking realities, Oddtoe specializes in 3D design and immersive spatial experiences tailored for private clients and government park planners. This is an artistic craft that brings visions to life through cutting-edge visualization, landscape design, and site-specific installations. Whether designing sculptural outdoor spaces, conceptualizing urban parks, or crafting bespoke private topiary gardens, every project is a fusion of artistic sensibility and technical precision.

For those seeking to push beyond conventional design, immersive experiences offer a new frontier in spatial storytelling. From interactive light installations to topographically inspired 3D sculptures, each piece is meticulously designed to engage and inspire. Government planners and landscape architects benefit from highly detailed visual proposals that communicate complex ideas with clarity, while private clients enjoy bespoke design solutions that reflect their unique aesthetic and spatial needs. Whether shaping a tranquil retreat or a dynamic public space, the focus remains on creating environments that not only serve a purpose but leave a lasting emotional impact.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_single_image image="12965" img_size="full" alignment="center" onclick="link_image"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" col_inner_shadow="box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)" col_inner_shadow_hover="box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)"][dfd_icon_list icon_margin="10" icon_bottom_spase="10" icon_color="#f2f2f2" icon_dec_size="100" icon_border_radius="10" icon_border_style="dotted" icon_border_width="2" del_height="1" main_style="style-4" icon_size="35" font_options="line_height:24"][dfd_icon_list_item icon="dfd-icon-robot dfd_icon_set-icon-robot"]

One animator. The full pipeline.

Generative AI animation is only as good as the person directing it. Oddtoe brings twenty years of illustration, motion design, and visual storytelling experience to every frame — AI handles the scale, and a non-boring human handles the design and the judgement. Makes it an easier process for you, the client.

[/dfd_icon_list_item][/dfd_icon_list][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="10" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="10" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30" screen_mobile_spacer_size="30"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][dfd_icon_list icon_margin="10" icon_bottom_spase="10" icon_color="#f2f2f2" icon_dec_size="100" icon_border_radius="10" icon_border_style="dotted" icon_border_width="2" del_height="1" main_style="style-4" icon_size="35"][dfd_icon_list_item icon="dfd-icon-pencil_2 dfd_icon_set-icon-pencil_2"]

Illustration first. Always.

In my career, I have been a political cartoonist, a puppeteer, a data visualizer, and a street artist. But my foundational skill is illustration. Since 2006, Oddtoe has been around the block, working for such organizations such as National Geographic.  

[/dfd_icon_list_item][/dfd_icon_list][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="10" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="10" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30" screen_mobile_spacer_size="30"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][dfd_icon_list icon_margin="10" icon_bottom_spase="10" icon_color="#f2f2f2" icon_dec_size="100" icon_border_radius="10" icon_border_style="dotted" icon_border_width="2" del_height="1" main_style="style-4" icon_size="35"][dfd_icon_list_item icon="dfd-icon-map_way dfd_icon_set-icon-map_way"]

Motion Design for Visual Facts

The integration of generative A.I. with traditional animation is a challenge. The design of non-fiction graphics, maps, and charts for a factual story is a challenge. Feeding the right data to a curiously-talented storyteller that happens to be a "bot"? That is a professional skill. 

[/dfd_icon_list_item][/dfd_icon_list][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="10" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="10" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30" screen_mobile_spacer_size="30"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="65" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="65" screen_tablet_spacer_size="55" screen_mobile_spacer_size="45"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_bg_style="canvas" dfd_enable_overlay="" css=".vc_custom_1776498629325{background-color: #332D26 !important;}" dfd_bg_color_value="#332D26"][vc_column][dfd_heading style="style_02" subtitle="Animation that treats the audience as intelligent." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_family:BebasNeueRegular" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_family:QwigleyRegular"]Generative AI Animator in Australia, Outside of Hollywood[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="30" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]The animators who work or have worked for Walt Disney all seem to come from Los Angeles. Maybe that's why movie animation all looks the same — either 2d Disney, 3d Pixar. At least, anime has given us new imagery and story types. But Hollywood animation isn't run by animators, but by studio heads who bear the risk for generating original stories and intellectual property (IP). Generative AI changes that equation. A single animator with the right tools and twenty years of animation experience can now produce work that would have required a studio of fifty. That's what Oddtoe offers. Not a cheaper version of the same thing. Something genuinely different.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]The subjects worth animating are rarely the easy ones. Science, history, technology, and deep dives into current events — that's where generative AI animation can help institutions and content creators that couldn't afford or lacked the talent to create beautiful explainers, animated videos, or documentary scenes.  Oddtoe is a generative AI animator. To me, Oddtoe is an animation house that can imagine 100 new animated comedies and kids' movies over breakfast. For ongoing clients, Oddtoe animates for YouTubers, helps influencers explain concepts better, or visualizes academic research in a way that is beyond what a typical university, think tank, or museum staffer could. These are clients who are telling stories that have a positive impact on their audiences; they're both educational and entertaining.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner Interested in a

next-level Comedy Content Creator?

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text item_animation="transition.fadeIn"]

 Oddtoe uses a "hybrid" method for comedy writing. The notepad of ideas, quotes, and funny scenes won't be replaced by generative artificial intelligence (AI) any time soon. AI is in its infancy for joke writing and comedic stories. However, I have included the technology in my workflow and writing process. 

Take a look at the possibilities for both generative AI & my own abilities. (Below: The Oddtoe-written animated comedy series, "Wire Taps", 2023)

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][dfd_delimiter delimiter_style="dfd-delimiter-with-icon" icon_size="15" delimiter_border_style="outset" icon_fontawesome="fas fa-arrow-circle-down" show_icon="enable_icon"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider slidertitle="Oddview — C: Youtube Hero Wire Taps" alias="oddview-c-youtube-hero-wire-taps"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_enable_overlay="" dfd_row_config="full_width_content" dfd_row_parallax="dfd-row-parallax" row_parallax_limit="50" css=".vc_custom_1779068225825{background: #cfe8e2 url(https://www.oddtoe.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Oddtoe-Caricature-Boutros-Boutros-Ghali-1.png?id=12654) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}"][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="75" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="75" screen_tablet_spacer_size="75" screen_mobile_spacer_size="65"][dfd_heading enable_delimiter="" style="style_02" subtitle="Humor evolves. This new era will be a step-change evolution." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_family:BebasNeueRegular|color:%23000000|letter_spacing:0" subtitle_font_options="tag:h2|color:%23000000|line_height:20" subheading_margin="margin-bottom:10px;"]A Stream of Comedic Skits & Stories[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/5"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/5"][vc_column_text css=""]The Venn diagram of Oddtoe is visualization, A.I., and humor. Comedy writing is bound to collide with ChatGPT, Claude, and other generative platforms. Thematic structures, plot devices, jokes — there's so much more to experience when an AI can contribute to the writer's room. In addition, I'm interested in new types of stories set in different locations. After all, not every sitcom needs to be made in New York or Los Angeles.[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="30" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/5"][vc_column_text css=""]Working with generative A.I. is like working with a talented musician who wants to jam with you when you want to. The future is generative humor. And a generative humorist needs to tend to his or her library of comedy data, much like what is used to train an A.I. with the cartoons from the New Yorker.  My personal hope is that, with a personal algorithm and deep knowledge of AI technology,[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="120" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_spacer_size="80" screen_tablet_spacer_size="80"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/5"][vc_column_text css=""]I can trust that my sense of humor is more or less used to train the model. And the stepping stones to building a funny story will gradually build on one another. Gags will progress to comedic scenes and soon to fully-fledged stories that hold together, but generate a new type of comedy writing. Add to the potential to cost-effectively visualize this content, and one can see the fun that's possible to design and animate.[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="30" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/5"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="710" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="710" screen_tablet_spacer_size="710" screen_mobile_spacer_size="660"][vc_column_text]

The Works of a...

More intelligence." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_family:BebasNeueRegular|color:%23000000|letter_spacing:0" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|color:%23000000"]Original Stories Generated by A.I. & the Human Mind[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="30" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]The era of multi-disciplinary artists is here. The tools and technology now available to artists and designers are astounding. As Oddtoe, I adore light projection, a little bit of nature — topiary, for instance — and heavy influences from cartooning and children's book illustration. My work is comedic. The visual style is very direct, with unique, detailed characters in full backgrounds. Good typography and textured surfaces also mark my style.[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]Oddtoe's typical clients are brands, advertisers, and publishers whose user experience has been dulled by the design's "race to the bottom" (think Canva-style design) — or worse, who've failed to stand out at all. Global brands with room for a more dynamic approach to illustration and animation also tend to gravitate toward "out-there" work. Also, for some reason, individuals, couples, or foundations with money ;) seem more interested in commissioning the most distinctive work. Them them.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="55" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="55" screen_tablet_spacer_size="55" screen_mobile_spacer_size="45"][dfd_button button_text="CONTACT ODDTOE" buttom_link_src="url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oddtoe.com%2Fcontact-oddtoe%2F|title:Contact%20Oddtoe" background="#8a8f6a" hover_background="#4e5041" border="border-style:none;|" hover_border="border-style:none;|" title_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal" style="style_6" padding_left="35" padding_right="35" title_font_options="line_height:45" title_google_fonts="yes"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="65" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="65" screen_tablet_spacer_size="65" screen_mobile_spacer_size="65"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

pages/14893.content:
[vc_row full_height="yes" bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_bg_style="canvas" dfd_bg_image_canvas="13943" dfd_bg_image_repeat_canvas="no-repeat" dfd_overlay_color="#040300" dfd_overlay_pattern_opacity="72" dfd_row_config="full_width_content" css=".vc_custom_1720170968283{background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}"][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="340" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="340" screen_tablet_spacer_size="240" screen_mobile_spacer_size="190"][dfd_heading enable_delimiter="" style="style_02" subtitle="Herzliche Willkommen" title_font_options="tag:h1|font_family:BebasNeueRegular" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_family:QwigleyRegular"]Berlin, Germany[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="580" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="500" screen_tablet_spacer_size="400" screen_mobile_spacer_size="350"][dfd_heading enable_delimiter="" style="style_02" subtitle="What I do..." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_family:BebasNeueRegular" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_family:QwigleyRegular"]Tourism, Art Projects, Park Design[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="15" screen_mobile_spacer_size="10"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]As a visual artist specializing in 3D visualization, garden design, and illustration, the grittier areas of Berlin, Germany are an endless source of inspiration. Certain neighborhoods stand out to me for the art and inspiration: the ever-changing graffiti and street art of Kreuzberg; the eclectic RAW-Gelände of Friedrichshain and its projection art museums;[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]and the organic, community-driven spirit of Neukölln for innovative garden designs. Whether it's Mitte's historical significance or Schlossgarten Charlottenburg's lovely display of topiary, Berlin provides the perfect canvas for creativity. The city offers one of the most unique blend of history, modernity, and artistic expression in all of Europe.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="120" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_mobile_spacer_size="80" screen_normal_spacer_size="80" screen_tablet_spacer_size="80"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_bg_style="image" dfd_bg_image_new="15239" dfd_bg_image_repeat="no-repeat" dfd_bg_img_attach="fixed" dfd_overlay_color="#322d26" dfd_overlay_pattern="transperant" dfd_row_config="full_width_content" css=".vc_custom_1722432583555{background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}"][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="120" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="120" screen_tablet_spacer_size="100" screen_mobile_spacer_size="80"][vc_column_text item_animation="transition.fadeIn"]

Looking to collaborate from

Berlin, JA?

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]As Oddtoe, a visual artist offering visualization, and design services, Berlin and Germany offer boundless opportunities for artistic collaboration. Oddtoe is dedicated to transforming artistic visions into reality, capturing the essence of Berlin’s diverse cultural tapestry. Inspired by the city's renowned museums, such as the Berlinische Galerie, [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]Oddtoe reimagines art and design in innovative ways. Germany has always had a great history of design. In that spirit, Oddtoe is dedicated to turning the creative visions of German companies into physical reality, blending the contemporary influences that make Berlin unique. To embark on a journey of creativity and visual transformation, contact Oddtoe today.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="120" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="120" screen_tablet_spacer_size="100" screen_mobile_spacer_size="80"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_enable_overlay="" one_page_title="Type of Client?" anchor="client"][vc_column width="1/4"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="80" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="60" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][vc_column_text item_animation="transition.fadeIn"]

You may be looking for character design, prop design, or any of Oddtoe's generative AI animation.

how does using a prop maker who specializes in digital models, generative AI, and 3d printing benefit you? Glad you asked. There are three main benefits: One: What you see is what you'll get. No surprises. This new generation of software modeling and prop construction is the best there is. And Oddtoe will keep you in the loop throughout the design and fabrication process. [/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]Two: An almost infinite amount of prototypes to see. Not sure exactly what you want? This is where generative AI in 3d modeling really helps out. Oddtoe can output a dozen early images or prototypes. Three: Speed. Because you, whether you're a Prop Master, Set Designer, or Head of Production, are included in the process of prop design from the start, approvals are quicker. This diminishes the need for redesigns. And as everyone on a production budget knows, time is money.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="55" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="55" screen_tablet_spacer_size="55" screen_mobile_spacer_size="45"][dfd_button button_text="CONTACT ODDTOE" buttom_link_src="url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oddtoe.com%2Fcontact-oddtoe%2F|title:Contact%20Oddtoe" background="#8a8f6a" hover_background="#4e5041" border="border-style:none;|" hover_border="border-style:none;|" title_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal" style="style_6" padding_left="35" padding_right="35" title_font_options="line_height:45" title_google_fonts="yes"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="55" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="55" screen_tablet_spacer_size="55" screen_mobile_spacer_size="45"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][rev_slider slidertitle="Compare Slider - Recently, Hollywood studios like Paramount Pictures, Warner Bros., and Sony Pictures have understood the need to source talent (and tax breaks) from Australia. Steamers like Apple+ and Netflix are also required to secure a portion of their content from the countries where their revenue comes from. This is one of the many reasons prop masters, art directors, and production supervisors are looking Down Under, to Australia for expertise in design, filling job roles with talent with Aussie accents. With a fully digital workflow, cloud-based connectivity, and a[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]beneficial difference in time zones,  Oddtoe services the North American market, specifically the entertainment industry's epicenter in Los Angeles, California: Hollywood. Domestically, the Australian movie, TV, and advertising industry is thriving. Backed by the Federal government, movie studios in the Docklands, Melbourne, on the Gold Coast in Queensland, and in Sydney, the need for prop makers, animators, and other artists has never been greater. So tap into the talent in Melbourne. For those in LA, you can fly direct — only a 14-hour flight. Or you can contact Oddtoe now and source an innovative prop maker without the jetlag.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="55" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="55" screen_tablet_spacer_size="55" screen_mobile_spacer_size="45"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][dfd_delimiter delimiter_style="dfd-delimiter-with-icon" icon_size="15" delimiter_border_style="dotted" icon_fontawesome="fas fa-question-circle" show_icon="enable_icon" icon_color="#ffffff"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_enable_overlay="" css=".vc_custom_1690360511153{background-color: #201b12 !important;}"][vc_column width="1/4"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][vc_column_text item_animation="transition.fadeIn"]

Questions for the

PROP MAKER?

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][dfd_accordion style="style-3" active_section="1" font_size="18" tab_title_google_fonts="yes" tab_title_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal" icon_size="14"][vc_tta_section title="What does a prop designer do?" tab_id="1685677784578-172f9372-59216fce-87a6"][vc_column_text]

A prop designer develops concepts & designs for the props required in the production of a movie, TV show, commercial, or theater performance.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What do prop makers do?" tab_id="1685677784323-438be9dd-da0e6fce-87a6"][vc_column_text]

Prop makers specialize in creating and constructing props for the entertainment industry. Essentially, they essentially bring the prop designer's concepts to life.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Are there prop makers in Australia?" tab_id="1685677784395-526dd6ff-b9c26fce-87a6"][vc_column_text]

Of course, silly! Prop makers in Australia are particularly prominent in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and Adelaide. Here there are heaps of theater companies, movie studios, & production houses. Most Australian prop makers also service events, movie, and TV productions in Asia, the U.S., and Canada, and Europe's entertainment industry in England, France, and Germany (+ others).

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="How is generative AI used in movies?" tab_id="1685677784507-83427dcb-7a756fce-87a6"][vc_column_text]

Generative AI is often used in the early stages of concept and design. Gradually, the use of AI will grow into other areas of TV and movie making, including character design, background art, and animation.

PROJECTION ARTIST FOR FESTIVALS

The business case for festivals is foot traffic. Local councils want it. Precinct associations want it. Sponsors want it. Projection art pulls crowds into laneways, parks, and main streets after dark — the hours retail and hospitality need most.

Want proof that this type of activation is working? In Australia, night-time pedestrian activity in Melbourne precincts now exceeds pre-pandemic levels, with the sector supporting 31,000 jobs and contributing $3.3 billion to the local economy.

A projection artist for hire is cheaper than a pyrotechnics team, safer than a fireworks permit, and reusable across multiple nights. One commission with Oddtoe. And then multiple activations in a large space, over one night or multiple nights.

That's good business math!

A CONSISTENT ART DIRECTOR

Generative A.I. art is great. However, it does come with limitations. The illustrations it creates are inconsistent. The images are fine for a once-off use. But brands and businesses have longer-term needs and a cohesive style to think about.

[/dfd_icon_list_item][/dfd_icon_list][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="60" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="60" screen_tablet_spacer_size="60" screen_mobile_spacer_size="60"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][dfd_icon_list icon_margin="10" icon_bottom_spase="10" icon_color="#f2f2f2" icon_dec_size="100" icon_border_radius="10" icon_border_style="dotted" icon_border_width="2" del_height="1" main_style="style-4" icon_size="35"][dfd_icon_list_item icon="dfd-icon-palette dfd_icon_set-icon-palette"]

A SKILLED ILLUSTRATOR & VISUALIZER

In my career, I have been a political cartoonist, a puppeteer, a data visualizer, and a street artist. But my foundational skill is illustration. Since 2006, Oddtoe has been around the block, working for such organizations such as National Geographic.

over 20 years. For better or for worse, generative AI is the impact that has hit professional illustration. I'm choosing to use it and ride where my illustration style takes the next few years of work. I have to say I am impressed — impressed with the impact it's having on parts of an illustrator's workflow: on ideation, world-building, and art direction, in particular. This age of generative AI will evolve artists quickly. And new illustration "gods" will come from the disruption.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]This disruptive technology has accelerated the scale of illustrations produced per year. — And it's all "hockey stick" growth from here out... Brands and businesses need to think about how they can create new imagery styles — and leave behind the gaudy era of business stock photography once and for all. The 2020s street art scene is full of talent — muralists, stencil heads, wheatpaste rebels, spray can heavyweights.

But I'm chasing the weird stuff. The off-kilter, can't-look-away kind of public art. Recent pieces, stuff I've seen and liked from other artists, and works-in-progress drop here whenever something makes me laugh.

Who hires a muralist?

Some of the people who hire muralists are government councils, tourist bureaus, property managers, restaurants, schools, or retail stores. A muralist is hired by those who want to beautify their property or by those who want to create a specific mood.   A muralist's job is to bring clients' ideas to life using color, space, and design. A good muralist will be able to work within a budget and produce great results with minimal supervision. However, while working on a project, if there are changes in the client's wishes or the scope of works expands unexpectedly, they may have to return with extra charges for the change in order to meet the client's expectations.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="1030" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="1030" screen_tablet_spacer_size="730" screen_mobile_spacer_size="580"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_bg_style="gradient" css=".vc_custom_1779012842154{background-color: #0C151B !important;}" dfd_bg_grad="background: -webkit-gradient(linear, left top, left bottom, color-stop(0%, #646464));background: -moz-linear-gradient(top,#646464 0%);background: -webkit-linear-gradient(top,#646464 0%);background: -o-linear-gradient(top,#646464 0%);background: -ms-linear-gradient(top,#646464 0%);background: linear-gradient(top,#646464 0%);"][vc_column width="1/6"][/vc_column][vc_column width="2/3"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="120" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_mobile_spacer_size="80" screen_normal_spacer_size="80" screen_tablet_spacer_size="80"][vc_column_text css=""]

How do you choose a muralist?

The best way to be sure that you'll get good results from your muralist is to ask for references or recommendations and check them out thoroughly before hiring one. A good candidate will have experience, great ideas, and a portfolio of works done before. And if you're hiring someone for the first time, ensure that they know their responsibilities clearly, so there'll be no issues regarding payment or delays on projects.[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="60" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="60" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][vc_column_text css=""]

Muralist for Painting Murals on Walls, Buildings, and Farm Silos

Painting murals on walls, buildings, and farm silos is a specialized job that takes years to master. The problem with muralists today is that they're specialized enough in their chosen mediums. They can't do everything from scratch, which means you have to hire multiple people to get things done right. This leads to delays and cost overruns for clients. Oddtoe offers a comprehensive package of services at an affordable price point so you don't have to worry about hiring multiple contractors or dealing with the headache of managing them all at once.[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="60" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="60" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][vc_column_text css=""]

The Proud History of Muralists in Australia

Australia punches above its weight in the art world. And street artists and muralists lead the way. Thankfully, there's a supportive culture at the Federal, State, and Council levels for large-scale commissions. A few well-known mural projects and councils in Australia come to mind: the King Street Murals, St. George Football Club, the Kings Cross Community Centre. Inner West Council, Wollongong Council, City of Melbourne, and the City of Sydney. In addition, the Silo Art Trail project is a shining example of how rural councils have found the power of murals to activate country town's cultures and economies. Numerous city street artists have plied their trades on the farm silos that decorate Australia.[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="120" Designing characters has changed so much in the past twenty years. Digital tools are certainly embedded now in a character designer's process. Think: Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Procreate. Think of scanners and 3d printers. And now let's drop in the 'most controversial elephant in the room': generative AI.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]Personal influences of mine are Winsor McCay, Walt Disney, Charles Schulz, or Bill Waterson: a great cartoon character is a great personality, designed to be a part of a wider story. Hollywood also asks them to be intellectual property (IP) and to be the next thing to entertain us across movies, TV, and video games. width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]Oddtoe specializes in 2d and 3d character design. I love a detailed brief. I'll take a mood board or other character sheets. And of course, a script is perfect to discover how a character is portrayed in writing. I've got a style for the design of characters. Realism isn't my thing; big heads are. Have a look through my portfolio and you'll get a sense of the style of character designs I like to conjure up. Once I've settled on a character's[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text] physical design, I'll often return to the drawing board. Settling for a Disney or Pixar cookie-cutter character isn't going to happen on my watch, so I often add more detail and uniqueness to any second draft. I want to avoid visual clichés. Villains and the main protagonists of a story often get finer attention and here I often take on influences from other artists. First, as inspiration. Second, to make sure I'm designing a character that's unlike anyone else out there.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="55" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="55" screen_tablet_spacer_size="55" screen_mobile_spacer_size="45"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][dfd_delimiter delimiter_style="dfd-delimiter-with-icon" icon_size="15" delimiter_border_style="dotted" icon_fontawesome="fas fa-question-circle" show_icon="enable_icon"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_enable_overlay="" css=".vc_custom_1690353985120{background-color: #c6acb6 !important;}"][vc_column width="1/4"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text item_animation="transition.fadeIn"]

Questions about

CHARACTER DESIGN?

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][dfd_accordion style="style-4" active_section="1" font_size="18" tab_title_google_fonts="yes" tab_title_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal" icon_size="14" tab_text_color="#000000"][vc_tta_section title="Can I see more examples of Oddtoe's character designs?" tab_id="1685677784578-172f9372-59216fce-87a6"][vc_column_text]

Absolutely. I think the best place to see my character design style is to check out my panel comics on Instagram.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What type of projects does Oddtoe work on?" tab_id="1685677784323-438be9dd-da0e6fce-87a6"][vc_column_text]

Books, web series comics, video games, and projects where the character designer is part of a larger production like animated TV shows and movies.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Who are the best types of characters to design in your job?" tab_id="1685677784395-526dd6ff-b9c26fce-87a6"][vc_column_text]

The juicier characters are the stupid ones, the over-the-top characters, villains, nerds, the overly vain characters, and the ones that have a bizarre way of looking at the world. It's not hard to get into those.

WHAT IS A ROBOTICIST?

[/dfd_heading][vc_column_text]In an era defined by technological advancements, the role of a roboticist has gained prominence. But what exactly is a roboticist? Simply put, a roboticist is a professional specializing in designing, developing, and operating robots. These individuals possess a unique blend of computer science, engineering, and artificial intelligence skills. Roboticists create robots for various applications, from manufacturing and healthcare to space exploration and entertainment. They work with cutting-edge technology, such as machine learning and sensor systems, to imbue robots with intelligence and autonomy. But for me, a creative roboticist is whatever I’d like to make it. A far more firm definition will soon be applied to this field of art.[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][dfd_heading content_alignment="text-left" delimiter_settings="border-bottom-style:dotted;|border-bottom-width:1px;|width:100px;|border-bottom-color:#d2d2d2;" delimiter_margin="margin-top:30px;margin-bottom:0px;" title_google_fonts="yes" title_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal" subtitle_google_fonts="yes" subtitle_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic" style="style_01" title_font_options="tag:h3" subtitle_font_options="tag:div|font_size:14" heading_margin="margin-bottom:10px;"]

Do You Work With Other Roboticists?

Robotics is moving so fast. Much faster than the art world. Oddtoe is there to catch the wake, so to speak, of the incredible work of the robotics community. To work alongside as humanity takes its best guess about how to work with these things. A creative roboticist isn’t the most important cog in this wheel, but I don’t see anyone else looking at making fun of robots, finding ways to let humans feel one last bit of superiority before the machines take our jobs and become our intimate partners ;).

 

What’s the Perfect Piece?

A robot is at the core of the idea. In itself, the robot is so interesting and intricate that I just need to imagine how it could be better, more interesting, how I can bring out features in the robot to the viewer. Could I place the robot in a different setting? Augment it somehow? Color or adorn it? What other forms can be brought to the party — projected light, kinetic sculpture, digital art?

 

What Idea Do I Want the Viewer to Have?

This is my favorite part of the creative process. Robots conjure up so much in the human mind: fascination, curiosity, fear, and I’d like to explore humor. Humor is a circuit breaker and let’s other deeper ideas possible once the viewer has let down their guard. It’s here that exciting possibilities exist, not all of which I can control as an artist. But I love that. Individuals will have individual takes on what I created and what I meant to convey.

That frees me up to not to have a point to my art ;)

Topiary and a Future for Zen Gardens

[/dfd_heading][vc_column_text item_animation="transition.slideDownIn"][/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=""]Shaving shrubs into impossible shapes, blending greenery with metal, masonry, and robots, Oddtoe is an extreme topiarist, a creative botanist and landscape designer — all-in-one. Central to his art practice, Oddtoe’s topiary garden designs incorporate sculpture and projected light and animation into unique landscapes to achieve an awe-inspiring, 'I haven’t seen this before’ effect. “I think uniqueness is important. I’m not here to create a rip-off Versailles garden. To me, an Oddtoe garden is whole new experience, a sensory garden. getting as many senses as possible — sight, sound, smell — on their tippy-toes and begging to know what’s around the next tree." I see gardens as immersive experiences. If I had to label or categorise the landscapes I like to design, three distinct types come to my mind: Zen, steampunk, and psychedelic.[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" THE RESORTS & SPAS WITH THE BEST TOPIARIST WINS

World-class resorts around the world are looking for points of difference for their gardens. Increasingly, these resorts are locations where their guests can wander, get lost (both physically and mentally), and can unwind. Zen gardens, if you will. Zen gardens can be quirky. Meditate with humour, I say. My favourite ingredients for a meditative space are plants, light, sound, and creatures (still or kinetic sculptures). The full sensory packet, but designed in a beautifully subtle way. Zen gardens are designed to mollify the mind. Here, auditory design becomes a key ingredient in my practice. Waterfalls, natural sounds — putting together a soundtrack for a garden experience is such a joy for a sensory designer.  

The Case for Extreme Topiary in the Age of Social Media

" In the age of social media, holiday resorts, museums, city gardens, and large-scale real estate developments are all looking for that extra edge, a visual something that gets a visitor to take that smartphone out of their pocket and snap a picture. A garden design to enhance well-being is a start. But a garden design needs to be more. Today, it's got to be bigger than life. It needs to be awe-inspiring.   [/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][vc_column_text css=""]

The Landscape Design Process for a Top Topiarist

Whether it’s for a museum piece, a holiday resort, or for a private garden, Oddtoe creates innovative landscapes using the same creative process he devised for graphic design, data visualization, and 3d illustration. Visual research followed by sketch work then a phase he calls “doubtful cliff jumps”. “I ask myself how I can push the envelope in a particular field. I may not use a particular plant or design - it may be impossible. But I need to imagine something, however implausible. If it’s landscape design, for me, topiary starts it off. I think in shapes. Ways to create a moment of intrigue in what’s being seen and experienced. A good topiarist knows geometry. A great topiarist knows psychology!"  

A Topiary Designer for Private Gardens

Topiary for a country house, holiday home, or public park, an Oddtoe garden experience can activate a dormant plot of land and transform it into a three-dimensional, organic piece of art. With Oddtoe, plant science can be combined with data science; digital art can be projected upon a gorgeous landscape. I love non-fiction, data visualization, & animated storytelling. I beg for more graphics whenever I watch documentaries, which is quite a bit. Animated maps, ways to visualize time and place, conceptual diagrams, crime reports, newspaper clippings — the visual library for a documentary animator is enormous. Our guide to what is generative AI animation covers how generative tools widen it further.[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]With a background in interactive design for kids at National Geographic, I now design data and stories for documentaries and for web series content. The visualizations I do are meant to shed light on the events and people in these documentaries. — factual, but also enjoyablely creative as to how they unfold. Facts are scenes in meticulously crafted shorts, helping the documentary present important information. Cinematography and illustration are combined and designed to make you see data in a way that’s not only understandable but downright pleasing. The visuals don’t just complement the content; they can elevate it, making even the most ordinary facts feel fun to discover. Think of scenes in your head: Page through a vintage scrapbook, where [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]animated illustrations, newspaper clippings, or crime reports visualize key points in your documentary This isn’t just about throwing graphics on a screen; it’s about having a 'go' at reimagining storytelling. Whether it’s a documentary that dives deep into complex events or a web series that uncovers hidden stories, I like how animation can add a new layer of depth and intrigue. I design data, scene explainers, and conceptual diagrams of all types. Information in motion that is not just understandable, but also oddly captivating.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_enable_overlay=""][vc_column width="1/4"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="120" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="100" screen_tablet_spacer_size="80" screen_mobile_spacer_size="80"][vc_column_text item_animation="transition.fadeIn"]

Be open-minded as to what style of visualizations could work within your film. See possibilities, different styles, and new visual influences. At the end of the day, this is my expertise inside your film — a team tasked with telling the visual story.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What type of projects does Oddtoe work on?" tab_id="1685677784323-438be9dd-da0e6fce-87a64dfd-367f1ddc-0240"][vc_column_text css=""]

I love reading non-fiction books. Personally, I like science, biographies, and geography, especially how it relates to people. But it's all good, to be honest.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Can I see more examples of Oddtoe's animation style?" tab_id="1685677784578-172f9372-59216fce-87a64dfd-367f1ddc-0240"][vc_column_text css=""]

Oddtoe creates documentary animation and exhibition films for cultural institutions, universities, and independent producers. Oddtoe is an animator of non-fiction narratives. width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]Sensory gardens are an area of landscape architecture that is often overlooked in the thinking of project planners. Sensory gardens often have the main purpose of reducing stress, anxiety, and depression through sensory stimulation. These sensory gardens can be created through several methods. These methods use botanical color palettes, sculpture, and nature-inspired features in order to create a memorable sensory garden design.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]There are designers who can help plan the concepts, visualizations, and eventual implementation of these sensory gardens. Sensory garden designers can come from many different types of backgrounds such as landscape architects, botanical artists, or horticulturists. Sensory garden designers are often hired for garden designs that are located in a public space, like a botanical park or kids' garden, or a private area such as a company courtyard.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_family:QwigleyRegular"]Why are sensory gardens becoming popular?[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="15" screen_mobile_spacer_size="10"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]One of the reasons sensory gardens are becoming popular in public spaces, company courtyards, and botanical parks is that this type of garden has been proven to reduce stress, anxiety, and depression. The main senses for sensory gardens are sight, sound, and touch. For example, a tactile decision a sensory garden design might make is to play with humidity. The garden design audience could then feel the moisture and coolness in a tropical portion of the garden. Botanical experiences have also become popular in certain communities because sensory garden designers include specific plants for children with sensory processing disorders, autism, and sensory integration challenges.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]Sensory processing disorder symptoms frequently include oversensitivity to sensory stimulation, under-sensitivity (hypersensitivity), or both. Children who suffer from sensory processing disorder can benefit greatly by spending time within sensory gardens designed specifically for sensory integration therapy. The sensory aspects of a garden design are just as important as the plants. For example, a sensory garden with beautiful blooms can be just as effective as sensory gardens that highlight sculptures and abstract artwork. A sensory garden should never contain sensory plants alone. There's more creativity to be had![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280"
